scoreRule: 1 point per correct MC item; 10 points maximum; local provisional grade only
description: Independent email comprehension EN/A1 draft; human review required.

tabs.title: Making a Plan
tabs.description: Follow the details of the invitation.

questions.q: Why does Ben want to tell Maya about Greenhill?
choices: He wants her to move into his house.
They were friends at his old school and he misses her.
He needs help with his garden.
He does not know anybody in town.
questions.explanation: Ben recalls their school lunches and games, showing that he misses his friend.

questions.q: What does Ben enjoy doing with his new friend Eva?
choices: Watching boats in the park.
Travelling to school by train.
Cooking sandwiches at home.
Playing football together on Fridays.
questions.explanation: Paragraph one says Ben and Eva play football on Fridays.

questions.q: Why does Ben ask about Maya's new class?
choices: He also wants to hear about Maya's life.
He wants to change her school timetable.
He needs to know the name of her teacher.
He wants her to do his homework.
questions.explanation: Ben explicitly says he wants to hear her news, not only send his own.

questions.q: How can Maya get from the station to the film night?
choices: She must buy a ticket for a taxi.
She can take a boat to the café.
Ben's dad can meet her and they can walk.
She must drive Ben's car.
questions.explanation: The email offers to meet Maya at the station and walk to the park.

questions.q: Why do families sit on blankets at the film night?
choices: The cinema has no chairs at all.
The film is shown outside in the park.
The film is watched on a train.
The town has no youth centre.
questions.explanation: People bring blankets and sit on the grass at the outdoor event.

questions.q: Why is a warm jacket a good idea for Maya?
choices: The film is about winter snow.
Maya must wear it at the station.
The café does not sell hot chocolate.
It can be cold near the park in the evening.
questions.explanation: Ben warns that evenings in Greenhill are cold.

questions.q: What should Maya tell Ben if she cannot visit?
choices: She can say she is busy and write back kindly.
She should stop being friends with him.
She should give no answer until Saturday.
She must buy a train ticket anyway.
questions.explanation: Ben says he understands if she is busy and asks her to reply.

questions.q: Why does Ben need Maya's answer before the weekend?
choices: He is moving to another town on Friday.
The park will close forever on Thursday.
He wants to know whether she can come to the event.
The film can start only with Maya.
questions.explanation: The invitation includes a request to write before Thursday.

questions.q: Which message would be a good answer from Maya?
choices: I do not want to read any more messages.
You must buy me a new football.
Your film is always too expensive.
Thanks! I'll tell you if I can come, and I have some school news too.
questions.explanation: A friendly reply should answer the invitation and respond to Ben's interest in her news.

questions.q: What can Maya do if it rains on Saturday?
choices: Wait in the park with no shelter.
Watch the film indoors at the youth centre.
Stay on the train until Sunday.
Play football in Ben's garden instead.
questions.explanation: Ben explains the alternative indoor venue when it rains.
